detaileddescription.para: Lexicographical compare via standard array as needed by predicate less<> to store points in std containers.. Else one would need iterators.
Old code does not implement a strict weak ordering and might cause undefined behaviour if used in a map returnx_<p.x_||(x_==p.x_&&y_<p.y_)||(x_==p.x_&&y_==p.y_&&z_<p.z_);
